versions.changelog:
feishu-update-doc 1.0.0

- Initial release: Update Feishu Docs with 7 modes (append, overwrite, replace_range, replace_all, insert_before, insert_after, delete_range).
- Supports precise content or section-based targeting using unique text ranges or headings.
- Allows simultaneous title updates with content modifications via the new_title parameter.
- Includes asynchronous update handling for large documents with task_id-based status queries.
- Detailed JSON-based input/output for flexible integration and error handling.
- Best practices and caveats documented for safe, lossless doc editing.
